description: Get the company's sync rules: the automatic tag changes applied when events fire (e.g. order placed -> add a tag). New companies start with the payment and ecommerce lifecycle rules; some older ones have none. Returns the effective rules plus isDefault, which is true when the company has explicitly opted into the inherited SaaS/ecommerce platform preset.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_sync_rules

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sync_rules` MCP tool.

isDefault.description: Whether the company uses the inherited SaaS/ecommerce platform preset.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

syncRules.description: Effective sync rules for the company.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
